title: Arithmetic and Geometric - Implicitly/Explicitly Defined Sequences - Convergence and Divergence
map_title: Arithmetic and Geometric / Implicit-Explicit Sequences, convergence

questions.question: Hvad karakteriserer en aritmetisk sekvens?
options: Forskellen mellem på hinanden følgende tal er konstant
Forholdet mellem på hinanden følgende tal er konstant
questions.explanation: I en aritmetisk sekvens er forskellen mellem på hinanden følgende tal konstant. (0:51)
questions.evidence: the difference between the numbers is a constant value.

questions.question: Hvordan får man hvert næste led i en geometrisk sekvens?
options: Ved at multiplicere det forrige led med et konstant tal
Ved at trække et konstant tal fra det forrige led
Ved at lægge et konstant tal til det forrige led
Ved at dividere det forrige led med et konstant tal
questions.explanation: I en geometrisk sekvens multipliceres hvert led med en konstant faktor. (1:03)
questions.evidence: geometric sequence instead of adding or subtracting, you are multiplying.

questions.question: Hvordan noteres den n‑te term i en sekvens?
questions.explanation: Notation $a_n$ bruges til at betegne den n‑te term. (1:54)
questions.evidence: you would write down a of n a of n.

questions.question: Hvad er $a_5$ i den viste sekvens?
questions.explanation: $a_5$ er 8, fordi femte led i sekvensen er 8. (2:15)
questions.evidence: Well, a of five would be eight, right?

questions.question: I en geometrisk sekvens angiver $n$ hvad?
questions.explanation: $n$ betegner leddets nummer, ikke selve værdien. (2:42)
questions.evidence: term only represents the term number, not the value of the term.

questions.question: Hvordan skrives en eksplicit defineret funktion for en sekvens?
questions.explanation: En eksplicit funktion har $a_n$ isoleret og lig med en funktion af $n$. (3:52)
questions.evidence: a of n will be equal to some function of n.

questions.question: Hvad er værdien af $a_1$ for den aritmetiske følge $a_n = 3n - 1$?
questions.explanation: Når $n=1$ giver udtrykket $3\cdot1-1=0$, så $a_1=0$. (4:21)
questions.evidence: a of 1 technically is equal to zero.

questions.question: Hvilken eksplicit formel beskriver den geometriske følge 1, 2, 4, 8, 16?
questions.explanation: Følgen fordobles hver gang, så $a_n = 2^{n-1}$ giver 1,2,4,8,16. (5:47)
questions.evidence: a of n would be equal to 2 ^ of n minus one

questions.question: Hvad er $a_1$ for den geometriske følge, når man bruger den eksplicitte formel?
questions.evidence: a of n would be equal to 2 ^ of n minus one

questions.question: Hvad er værdien af det femte led i den eksplicit definerede sekvens?
questions.explanation: Det femte led beregnes som $2^{5-1}=2^4=16$. (6:18)
questions.evidence: fifth term 2 ^ of 5 minus one. Well this is equal to 2 ^ 4 which is equal to 16.

questions.question: Ifølge den rekursive definition $a_n = a_{n-1}+2$, hvad er $a_3$ når $a_2 = 2$?
questions.evidence: a of three ... a of two is equal to two. And we if we add two to that we get four.

questions.question: Skriv den rekursive formel for den implicit definerede sekvens.
questions.explanation: Formlen beskriver, at hvert led afhænger af det foregående plus 2. (7:16)
questions.evidence: a of n is equal to a of n minus one + 2

questions.question: Hvad er den tredje termværdi i sekvensen som nævnes i starten?
questions.explanation: Den tredje term er angivet til at være fire. (8:04)
questions.evidence: Four is the third term value of this sequence.

questions.question: Hvordan kan man omskrive den implicitte sekvens som nævnes i videoen?
questions.explanation: Videoen viser, at man kan skrive a_{n+2}=a_{n+1}. (8:23)
questions.evidence: you have a of n + 2 is equal to a of n plus one

questions.question: Hvis du vil finde femte term $a_5$, hvilken værdi af $n$ skal du indsætte i relationen $a_{n+1}=a_n$?
questions.explanation: For at få $a_{5}$ skal $n+1=5$, så $n=4$. (8:54)
questions.evidence: n + one would mean that n is equal to four

questions.question: Hvorfor kan man i dette tilfælde ikke finde $a_1$?
questions.explanation: Man kan ikke finde $a_1$ fordi det ville betyde at $n$ er nul. (10:18)
questions.evidence: So that's why you can't really find a of one in this case because a of one would mean that n is equal to zero here

questions.question: Hvilket udsagn om eksplicit definerede funktioner er korrekt?
options: $a_n$ appears on both sides of the equation.
They must include $a_{n+1}$ on the left side.
$a_n$ appears only on one side of the equation.
questions.explanation: Eksplicit definerede funktioner har kun $a_n$ på den ene side af ligningen. (11:40)
questions.evidence: explicitly defined functions just have a of n. That is all on one side of the equation.

questions.question: According to the video, how is an explicitly defined function characterized in terms of $a_n$?
questions.answer: It has $a_n$ on only one side of the equation.
questions.explanation: Eksplcitt definerede funktioner har $a_n$ kun på én side af ligningen. (11:40)
questions.evidence: explicitly defined functions just have a of n. That is all on one side of the equation.

questions.question: Hvad sker der, hvis man lægger tallene 1,2,3,4,… sammen helt ud til uendelig?
options: Summen konvergerer til et endeligt tal.
questions.explanation: Summen af de naturlige tal vokser uden grænse, så rækken divergerer. (13:59)
questions.evidence: you get infinity, right? So that means that this sequence diverges.

questions.question: Ifølge videoen, hvad er værdien af $a_5$ i det givne eksempel?
questions.explanation: Ved at anvende rekursionsformlen får man $a_5 = a_4 + a_3 = 2 + 3 = 5$. (13:17)
questions.evidence: Therefore, 2 + 3 should equals a of 5, which it does. Five is equal to five.

questions.question: If the sum of the terms of a sequence grows without bound, what does the speaker say about the sequence?
options: It diverges (goes to infinity or negative infinity)
It oscillates between positive and negative values
It converges to a finite limit
It becomes constant after a certain index
questions.explanation: En uendelig vækst i summen betyder divergens. (14:08)
questions.evidence: if the sequence after adding everything up goes to infinity then your sequence diverges. That's what we call ... or going to negative infinity as well.

questions.question: Hvilken faktor beskriver forholdet mellem på hinanden følgende led i den givne konvergerende sekvens?
questions.explanation: Hvert led er en fjerdedel af det foregående. (14:41)
questions.evidence: the pattern between all these are that they're 1/4 of each other. So this is 1/4 of the next one.

questions.question: Hvad kaldes det, når man lægger alle led i en sekvens sammen?
questions.explanation: Summen af alle led i en sekvens betegnes som en serie. (16:26)
questions.evidence: if you add all the numbers in a sequence, it's called a series.
